clause_zh: 主要OEM已将碳中和承诺延伸至价值链并向供应商传导：吉利2045全链路 · 长城2045 · 长安2045（峰值2027）· 奇瑞2047价值链 · 小米2040运营碳中和 · 蔚来2035单车LCA−43%（基年2023）；吉利与蔚来已承诺SBTi
clause_en: Major OEMs extend carbon neutrality to the value chain: Geely 2045 full-chain; GWM 2045; Changan 2045 (peak 2027); Chery 2047 value-chain; Xiaomi 2040 operations; NIO −43% per-vehicle LCA by 2035 (base 2023); Geely & NIO committed to SBTi
source: 吉利控股2024可持续报告 · 奇瑞2024/2025 ESG报告 · 长安2025 ESG报告 · 蔚来2025 ESG报告（2026-05）· 小米气候白皮书2023 · 详见调研MD
suppliers: Tier-1 · 全部产线;运营边界

clause_zh: OEM中期目标向供应商传导：长城制造碳强度−18% · 奇瑞单车制造−60% by 2030（基年2023 · 已实现−9.42%）· 小米范围1+2 −70% by 2030（基年2021）· 长安2027达峰；Autoliv自身SBTi：范围1&2 −75% by 2030（基年2018）
clause_en: OEM interim targets cascade to suppliers: GWM mfg intensity −18%; Chery per-vehicle mfg −60% by 2030 (base 2023 · −9.42% achieved); Xiaomi S1+2 −70% by 2030 (base 2021); Changan peak 2027; Autoliv own SBTi: S1&2 −75% by 2030 vs 2018
source: 奇瑞2025 ESG报告目标进展表 · 小米气候白皮书2023 · Autoliv 2025可持续发展报告（SBTi）

clause_zh: 奇瑞要求核心一级供应商2030年绿电占比≥60%（2025年新设目标 · 已完成138家绿电摸排 · 95家碳管理培训）；吉利要求一级核心供应商2025年100%绿电（2024实绩：核心供应商绿电超50% · 近半数达100%）；小米汽车链T1平均绿电43% · 2025年目标50%以上；长城/长安/蔚来为引导性条款
clause_en: Chery requires ≥60% renewable electricity for core Tier-1 by 2030 (new 2025 target · 138 suppliers surveyed); Geely requires 100% RE for core Tier-1 by 2025 (2024 actual: >50% avg · near half at 100%); Xiaomi auto Tier-1 avg 43% · 50%+ target for 2025; GWM/Changan/NIO encourage without mandate
source: 奇瑞2025 ESG报告 · 吉利2024 ESG报告+BRIC绿色供应链案例 · 小米2024 ESG报告
evidence: I-REC 采购意向 · 缺失

clause_zh: 吉利对核心供应商提出再生材料比例要求：再生钢20% · 再生铝30% · 再生塑料25%；奇瑞推广100%再生铝免热处理一体压铸（获UNIDO 2025奖）并在准则新增零毁林/生物多样性条款；关键金属与织物件须声明再生料比例并提供第三方验证（含气体发生器金属壳体）
clause_en: Geely sets recycled-content ratios for core suppliers: steel 20% · aluminum 30% · plastics 25%; Chery deploys 100% recycled-Al heat-treatment-free die-casting (UNIDO 2025 award) plus zero-deforestation clauses; key metal & fabric parts must declare recycled content with third-party verification incl. inflator housings
source: 吉利2024 ESG报告 · 奇瑞2024/2025 ESG报告+UNIDO获奖报道（2025-12）

clause_zh: 供应商须签署行为准则并遵守劳工条款（吉利：合同组成部分+要求签署；奇瑞：主合同附件+盖章承诺栏 · 一级100%签署；小米：合作前提 · 周60h/七休一/禁扣薪处罚；赛力斯：RBA全套含道德招聘/同工同酬；小鹏：禁招聘费/扣证件；蔚来：不满足最低标准即不合作）；SAQ 5.0 人权政策须覆盖12项（童工·工资·工时·现代奴役·道德招聘·结社自由·反歧视·女性权益·DEI·少数群体·土地权·安保力量）；奇瑞设十大红线并因劳工问题淘汰供应商
clause_en: Suppliers must sign the CoC and meet labor clauses (Geely: contract-integral + signing; Chery: contract annex + seal · 100% Tier-1 signed; Xiaomi: cooperation prerequisite · 60h/wk · 1-in-7 rest · no wage-deduction discipline; Seres: full RBA incl. ethical recruiting & equal pay; XPENG: no recruitment fees / no ID retention; NIO: no cooperation below minimum standards); SAQ 5.0 HR policy must cover 12 topics; Chery enforces ten red lines incl. labor violations
source: 7家OEM供应商行为准则原文（见S维度专题MD §6）· SAQ 5.0问卷Q5a · 各OEM ESG报告2024/2025
evidence: CoC 签署 ✓ · 问卷缺失

clause_zh: 供应商须对负责任矿产开展OECD框架尽调并按模板申报：奇瑞覆盖3TG+钴/云母/锂/镍/石墨 · 要求CMRT/EMRT/PRT申报 · 拒不配合可暂停合作（2025年606家完成CMRT）；小鹏扩展矿物含钴锂镍云母石墨 · 来自CAHRA须立即通报；蔚来要求按需提供3TG+钴冶炼厂/精炼厂信息（EU 2017/821）；小米3TG+钴（2024尽调反馈率100%）；吉利要求矿产尽调+透明可追溯（GeeTrace区块链）；SAQ 5.0 Q20c/20d要求公司级CMRT/EMRT——气囊ECU电子件/织带/皮革均可能命中优先材料清单
clause_en: Suppliers must conduct OECD-framework responsible-minerals due diligence with template filings: Chery covers 3TG+Co/mica/Li/Ni/graphite via CMRT/EMRT/PRT with suspension for non-cooperation (606 filings 2025); XPENG extended minerals + immediate CAHRA notification; NIO smelter/refiner info on request per EU 2017/821; Xiaomi 3TG+Co (100% response 2024); Geely due diligence + GeeTrace traceability; SAQ 5.0 Q20c/20d requires company-level CMRT/EMRT — airbag ECU electronics/webbing/leather likely hit the priority-materials list
source: 奇瑞负责任矿产声明 · 小鹏CoC第四章 · 蔚来供应链可持续政策§3.6.2 · 小米CoC§4.6 · SAQ 5.0 Q20
evidence: CMRT 提交 ✓ · EMRT 缺失

clause_zh: OEM保留尽调与审核权并要求申诉机制：奇瑞可委托第三方审计 · 访谈总经理至员工 · 复制摘录文件 · 违约可终止合作；吉利/小鹏保留事先通知的检查评估权；蔚来96次现场ESG评审（2025）· 小米611家现场审核（2024 · 2家终止合作）；SAQ 5.0 Q4a要求申诉机制具备11项特征（独立·保密·可匿名·不报复·年度评估等 · 对标德国LkSG§8）；RSCI现场审核11模块（工时抽20人×3个月交叉验证 · 范围含宿舍）· FULL标签有效期36个月且可作SAQ Q6最高档证据
clause_en: OEMs retain due-diligence & audit rights and require grievance mechanisms: Chery may commission third-party audits with interviews down to worker level and document copying · breach may terminate cooperation; Geely/XPENG hold notice-based inspection rights; NIO 96 on-site ESG reviews (2025) · Xiaomi 611 on-site audits (2024 · 2 terminated); SAQ 5.0 Q4a requires 11 grievance-mechanism features (independent · confidential · anonymous · non-retaliation · annual review; aligned to German LkSG §8); RSCI on-site audit spans 11 modules (20-worker × 3-month wage/hour sampling · dorms in scope) · FULL label valid 36 months and accepted as top-tier SAQ Q6 evidence
source: 奇瑞CoC§5.7-5.8 · SAQ 5.0 Q4a · RSCI Assessment Requirements 2026-02 · 各OEM ESG报告
evidence: SAQ已提交 · RSCI未审核（示例）
suppliers: 全部产线;宿舍纳入范围

clause_zh: OEM要求Tier-1/Tier-2碳与活动数据逐级披露并接入其碳数据平台：吉利"吉碳云"（590+家供应商PCF核算）· 比亚迪"i迪碳链" · 蔚来可持续评估2.0（100+指标 · 96次现场评审）· 北汽CICES（130+家填报）· 行业CPP碳公示平台；客户材料确认"Required Tier-2 · ALV provided accordingly"（2026-03）
clause_en: OEMs require tiered Tier-1/Tier-2 carbon & activity data disclosure via their platforms: Geely JiTan Cloud (590+ suppliers PCF); BYD i-DiTanLian; NIO Sustainability Assessment 2.0 (100+ indicators · 96 on-site reviews); BAIC CICES (130+ suppliers); industry CPP platform; client deck confirms "Required Tier-2 · ALV provided accordingly" (Mar 2026)
source: 客户脱敏材料（2026-03）· 吉利/蔚来/比亚迪/北汽ESG报告 · IPE研究简报2025 · 中汽数据CPP平台
